title: The original dance challenge: a peacock's display
caption:
He's been doing this routine far longer than any trend.

The train isn't the tail: it's made of hugely elongated upper tail coverts. Males shed it every year and regrow it before the breeding season.

Source: Dakin et al. 2016 (PLOS ONE), Britannica.  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
